turns.speaker: agent_1
turns.text: Hi there! What matters most to you? I mainly need food for my group.

turns.speaker: agent_2
turns.text: Firewood is my priority, food I can go without. Sounds like we're not really competing!

turns.speaker: agent_1
turns.text: Perfect. How about you take all 3 firewood, I take all 3 food, and we split the water?

turns.speaker: agent_2
turns.text: That works well for both of us. Deal!
